notes.title: Version 0.50 - Cosmetics, Achievements, Balance, & More
notes.content:
After over a month of work, Version 0.50 has been released! A lot of new stuff got added this patch, including Achievements, Cosmetics, Balance Changes, and more! We've also cleaned up the UI considerably and fixed a fair number of bugs. Check out our video preview below, and read on for the full patch notes!

[previewyoutube=XgBZpk6R-bA;full][/previewyoutube]

Steam Achievements

https://i.imgur.com/O2YOGKr.jpg
Each map now has 13 Achievements tied to them, resulting in a total of 104 Achievements! These include:
Clear by Difficulty
Clear by Speed
Clear by Random + Chaos
Clear by Extreme
Get X Score


https://i.imgur.com/yG6Rd8z.jpg
Now, as you play the game, you'll gain XP, used to increase your Level. Additionally, each Achievement you complete provides you with a burst of XP,

Each time you level up, you are rewarded with a Shop Point, which can be used to unlock Cosmetics for your Builder. Speaking of which...


Builder Cosmetics

https://i.imgur.com/UF2qnTj.jpg
You can now customize your Builder! On top of that, there's multiple accessories you can add to make them look particularly snazzy! In total, we have:
7 Builders
7 Hats
6 Trails
6 Wings
And an extra Builder with ludicrous level requirements.
Don't worry, we'll fill in more Cosmetics and Achievements over time to fill the gap.


Map Changes

Lava
https://i.imgur.com/aOxfGAS.jpg
The oddball top-left corner has been adjusted so that it's actually buildable there, and part of the path on the right side has been removed, adding a bit more difficulty to this map.

Tropical
https://i.imgur.com/PcjXSf8.jpg
The first island has been outright removed, causing creeps to immediately head down on that first bend. The path is roughly 20% shorter now, and it makes it so Earth & Quake aren't superior to everything else on this map. Still useful, just not blatantly OP.

Winter
https://i.imgur.com/cctofdb.jpg
Once more, the Winter map has been given a new layout! The previous one wasn't bad per se, but it was sort of a repeat of existing maps and required nothing new to beat it. In this layout, creeps wrap around the sides, then circle around the middle before exiting. With this, it's back to being the most difficult map by far.

Grand City
https://i.imgur.com/nbjwgqr.jpg
And lastly, the Co-op map has been tweaked. The longer portals on the outside have been pulled in a bit, and the center killzone is no longer quite as generous. Its visuals are still prototype, though that may change in the coming weeks...


Improvements
An option has been added under Graphics called VFX Toggle. Turning it off will drastically reduce the amount of VFX that renders.
Holding Shift while Drag-Building will now let you properly queue up towers.
Allied towers in Team & Co-op games now have an indicator hovering over them, making it easier to distinguish your towers from your allies'.
If there's two players in a lobby and the host readies up while the other player leaves, it'll now unready the host.
Elemental Boss labels now list "Level 1" instead of "Lvl. 1"


Fixes
Potentially fixed a major bug where you could somehow upgrade Level 2 Duals into Arrow Towers.
Fixed a major bug where a Disease Tower could inflict near infinite damage and somehow freeze the game as a result.
Fixed a bug where getting disconnected from a lobby wouldn't actually kick you out of the lobby, thus breaking the lobby and preventing anyone from readying up.
Fixed a bug in Co-op where way more Ronalds were spawning than intended.
Fixed a bug that allowed Team & Co-op Scores to land on the Leaderboard.When this gets added properly, they'll each have their own categories.

Ronald Runs can no longer submit to the Leaderboard.
Fixed a bug where, if you kill an Elemental while having the Tower Table open, it wouldn't update the table properly.
Fixed initial language select missing the majority of the options.


New Tower Table

https://i.imgur.com/wrRoCEf.jpg
The Tower Table has received a format update. With this, everything is much better organized:
Elements run left-to-right, just like your build bar and HUD.
All Buff towers are now in a single row.
All Slows & Amplify towers are now in a single row.

In order to apply this though, a few towers had their Damage Types shuffled around...


Balance
All 700 Range Towers have been buffed to 750 Range.
In particular, certain aggravations with their placement aren't as much of pain.

Fire damage reduced from 25 / 150 / 900 / 9000 to 20 / 120 / 720 / 7200Damage bonus per second increased from 0.5 / 3 / 18 / 180 to 1 / 6 / 36 / 360

Nature damage increased from 75 / 450 / 2700 / 27000 to 80 / 480 / 2880 / 28000
Initial damage bonus decreased from 50% to 40%

Ice damage increased from 700 / 2800 / 11200 to 750 / 3000 / 12000
Poison damage-per-second increased from 80 / 320 / 1280 to 90 / 360 / 1440
Duration reduced from 10 seconds to 9 seconds

Mushroom damage increased from 80 / 320 / 1280 to 85 / 340 / 1340
Howitzer damage increased from 160 / 640 / 2540 to 165 / 660 / 2640
Trickery effect tweaked:
Old - This is a Buff Tower. Every 15 seconds, it clones a Non-Buff Tower for 10 / 20 / 60 seconds. A cloned tower cannot be cloned again for 60 seconds.
New - This is a Buff Tower. Every 15 seconds, it clones a Non-Buff Tower that deals 65% / 130% / 400% damage for 15 seconds. A cloned tower cannot be cloned again for 60 seconds.

Arcane renamed to Infernal:
Damage type changed from Darkness to Fire

Electricity renamed to Lightning:
Damage type changed from Fire to Light
Number of bounces reduced from 6 to 4
Damage decrease per bounce changed from 20% less to 15% less
Bounce range reduced from 1150 to 1000

Wisp damage type changed from Light to Water
Astral damage reduced from 1800 / 7200 to 1600 / 6400
However, projectile speed has been doubled

Runic search AoE increased from 200 to 225
Flooding damage increased from 350 / 1400 to 375 / 1500
Impulse damage reduced from 3600 / 14400 to 3400 / 13600
Corrosion damage amp reduced from 15% / 45% to 15% / 40%
Jinx damage ticks reduced from 7% / 18% to 6% / 15%
Polar now returns the full HP removed after 15 seconds instead of only returning half
Golem effect changed:
Old - Each time it kills a creep, this tower loses 300 / 1200 damage for 2 seconds.
New - After attacking for 3 seconds, this tower stops attacking for 3 seconds.
Damage increased from 1400 / 5600 to 2400 / 9600
Projectile speed increased by 25%

Periodic damage increased from 28000 to 32000

Due to the extensive balance changes as listed above, the Leaderboard has been reset.


Visuals
The UI has been cleaned up, removing most of its bulkiness in favor of a simpler look.
Texture quality has been improved slightly.
Updated the water shader being used on Well, Flooding, Golem, & Wisp towers.
Updated the visuals of Lightning, Infernal, & Wisp Towers to reflect their new Damage Types.
Various other little tweaks to reduce the overall brightness of the VFX.



And that's it for today's patch! A lot got added, a lot got changed, and lot got fixed. There's a handful of things we wanted to get implemented, but just didn't have the time to for this patch. Stuff like:
Team & Co-op Leaderboard Support
The ability to change your player color
Improved Tower Table functionality
And more

Fret not, expect these to be added in the coming weeks! In general, expect to see regular updates once more every week or so. The only reason this update took so long is because all of its systems were integrated together, requiring them to all be finished at once.


Lastly, our Discord server has finally been improved with a Role Bot, meaning you can now opt yourself into the LFG role (Looking For Game) without requiring someone to give you the role manually. Check the pinned messages under our #looking-for-game channel and give the post a thumbs up!
Element TD 2 Discord

notes.title: 0.50 Patch Preview 1 - Balance Updates
notes.content:
Apologies for the lack of updates recently. The upcoming Version 0.50 has a lot in it, and it's not something that can be released one piece at a time. Many of its pieces rely on each other, so it's taking longer than usual. Rest assured, it should release in about a week and a half!

In the meantime, here's some balance updates to look forward to!

Map Tweaks

https://i.imgur.com/aOxfGAS.jpg
For Lava, the oddball top-left corner has been adjusted so that it's actually buildable there, and part of the path on the right side has been removed, adding a bit more difficulty to this map.

https://i.imgur.com/PcjXSf8.jpg
And for Tropical, the first island has been outright removed, causing creeps to immediately head down on that first bend. The path is roughly 20% shorter now, and it makes it so Earth & Quake aren't superior to everything else on this map. Still useful, just not blatantly OP.

Tower Tweaks

https://i.imgur.com/92qIsyg.png

The Tower Table is receiving a format update! Yes, this means you'll have to relearn the tower spots, but I'm sure you'll get used to it in time. With this updated format:Elements run left-to-right, just like your build bar and HUD.
All Buff towers are now in a single row.
All Slows & Amplify towers are now in a single row.
Utilities are still scattered, but we'll fix that in a future update. Namely when new towers finally get added.


In general, it's much more organized and consistent. Though in order to apply those consistencies, you might notice a few towers got their damage types shuffled around:Electricity - Used to be Fire, is now Light
Arcane - Used to be Darkness, is now Fire
Wisp - Used to be Light, is now Water


While this does harm a few builds (namely two 3-element builds that were a tad too perfect in multiplayer anyways), it fixes several redundancies, like having both Solar & Electricity or Arcane & Disease.

Lastly, two towers are getting some ability tweaks:
Trickery:Before - This is a Buff Tower. Every 15 seconds, it clones a Non-Buff Tower for 10 / 20 / 60 seconds. A cloned tower cannot be cloned again for 60 seconds.
After - This is a Buff Tower. Every 15 seconds, it clones a Non-Buff Tower that deals 65% / 130% / 400% damage for 15 seconds. A cloned tower cannot be cloned again for 60 seconds.
In other words, Level 3 Trickery will no longer block out the entire map from being used when you have too much gold.


Golem:Before - Each time it kills a creep, this tower loses 300 / 1200 damage for 2 seconds.
After - After attacking for 3 seconds, this tower stops attacking for 3 seconds.
Golem was always meant to be a finisher tower. However, its previous effect was counterintuitive to its nature. With the new effect, its average damage is lower than before, but its burst damage is insanely high. If you can maximize its uptime and minimize its downtime, it'll be a powerful asset in your defense.


A number of other towers will be receiving balance tweaks, but they're still in testing and not quite finalized. Exact tweaks will be revealed on patch release.


And that's it for this preview! We'll have a preview out next week, which will show off the other juicy part of Version 0.50 - cosmetics for your Builder!

If you want to stay up-to-date on previews, as usual, join our Discord server:

notes.title: Version 0.49 - Teams, Bug Fixes, and More Localization
notes.content:
For this patch, Version 0.49, we've added a Teams Mode, which should appeal to those of you asking for the experience of Co-op but with just 2 Players, we fixed that darn freeze error (hopefully once and for all), added Russian, Chinese, French, & Finnish Localization, and other improvements. Check it out below!


FeaturesTeams Mode added!2 Players to a zone, allows up to 2v2v2v2!
You can even solo it, meaning you reap all the gold benefits instead of splitting it with a partner.
Supports all of the existing maps, except Grand City, which we kept as-is for the existing Co-op Mode.

Russian, Chinese, French, & Finnish Localization Support added!
Expanded the Frame Cap options.60 is still the default, but you can now select options for 90, 120, and Uncapped.
FYI, if you select Uncapped, we recommend turning on Vsync via NVIDIA/AMD.


Improvements & FixesFixed a major bug where Jinx could sometimes freeze the game.
In a Co-op Game, if someone leaves the game, it will now forcibly sell all of their towers, and then split their gold evenly among the remaining players.Likewise, in the new Teams Mode, the respective partner reaps the rewards from someone leaving.

Optimized the tower targeting code, which should help with end-game lag.Late-game Co-op is still a lagfest; HOWEVER, going off-screen should actually help now.

During a Multiplayer Pause as a result of lag or something, the game will now display "Synchronizing".
Fixed a bug where Disease could deal so much damage, it could somehow heal a creep or Elemental Boss back to full.
Fixed a bug where, if you built a tower from the Tower Table, then opened the table again, it would retain the highlights from the previous tower.
Fixed a bug where having a UI Scale other than x1.0 would cause a black bar to show up on the Extras menu.
Fixed Easy Difficulty displaying a difficulty multiplier of x0 instead of x0.25.
Fixed a bug where viewing a replay with a clear time longer than 55 minutes would display a speed multiplier of x0.


That's it for this patch! Our next patch, Version 0.50, is looking to be a bit chunky. It's probably going to take us upwards of 3 weeks before we release it, but it should be worth the wait. A little preview of what's to come:Cosmetic Rewards, finally!
Steam Achievements
Balance update, including a Leaderboard Reset
Leaderboard support for Teams & Co-op


Regarding the Challenges --> Campaign overhaul, a good chunk of it is reliant on the next patch's updates, so that's still some ways away.

As we get closer to release, we'll provide a more comprehensive patch preview. In the meantime, enjoy Teams Mode and the latest fixes, and as usual, if you'd like to provide feedback or are looking for games, you can join our Discord:
Element TD 2 Discord

Added an Extras button to the Main Menu.The menu Tower Table has been moved here.
Also moved the Replays button here.
Added a Credits screen. We'll be updating this over time as we get more Translations implemented.


Quality of LifeWhen hovering over a creep, there's now a hover indicator.
There's now a visual spawn and leak effect.
Doubled default Zoom In/Out speed.
Duel Mode: In the Lobby, it now gives you an explanation of how the game mode works, to clarify that it is different from the standard game.
Duel Mode: When someone uses an ability, a message appears on screen.
Duel Mode: The enemy portal is now marked with a skull marker, so that you can tell which one enemy creeps will spawn from.


Bug FixesFixed a major bug where the game could randomly freeze, resulting in everyone's gold gradually draining, resulting in a soft-lock.
Fixed a major bug where someone pausing the game and then quitting could lock everyone else in the game.It now automatically unpauses when they leave.

Fixed a major bug where the end-game Scorescreen sometimes wouldn't appear, resulting in the game next ending and thus your score not being submitted to the Leaderboard.
Fixed a bug where it was possible to get a God Mode score uploaded to the Leaderboard.
Fixed multiplayer input lag getting to ludicrously high levels.
Fixed a bug where you could pause more than 3 times in Multiplayer.
Fixed an annoying bug where clicking on a creep wouldn't actually select or target them.
Fixed a bug where creeps were doing a spin-dance turn after spawning on certain maps.
Fixed the portals on the Temple map floating in mid-air.
Fixed one of the portals getting hidden by a mountain on the Winter map.
Fixed Scoreboard listing Builder instead of Player Name.We're not sure why it said that before, nor do we know how it took us this long to notice.

Co-op Mode: Everyone's score is now totaled, instead of individual.
Co-op Mode: Fixed incorrect starting gold on Ronald Run length.
Co-op Mode: Fixed only Player 1 getting the Freebie Essence.
Co-op Mode: Fixed only Player 1 hearing Wave Start/End sounds.
Duel Mode: Fixed a bug where, if you have a group of towers selected and they get Frost Zoned, you could sell them.
Duel Mode: Fixed a bug where, if you select a group of towers that were already Frost Zoned, you couldn't sell them even when the duration ended.
Duel Mode: Fixed Flamethrower's napalm not healing your creeps.


OptimizationWe've disabled Vsync, and instead, the framerate is capped at 60, resulting in much lower GPU usage.
Certain laggy towers, like Nature 3 and Trickery 2 & 3 are slightly less shiny in favor of not halving the framerate.
Projectiles have received some optimization as well.


BalanceIn Random, the earliest a Level 3 Elemental can spawn is now Wave 35 instead of Wave 30.


Next week, by popular demand, look forward to Teams Mode, which will enable 2 Player Co-op on all of our standard maps. Also look forward to balance updates in the next week or so. For the time being though, the game should run better and no longer be prone to spontaneous freezes and crashes.

As usual, if you find bugs, or you're looking for games, join our Discord and ask away!
Join the Element TD 2 Discord

notes.title: Version 0.47 - Localization, Tower Table Filters, Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Version 0.47 is now out! In this release, we have Localization for several langues, Tower Table Filters have been added, there's our usual bout of network improvements and Bug Fixes, and we now have a way to preview builds on the Main Menu. We also have a fancy new promo:

[previewyoutube=qYjfDzaYI8I;full][/previewyoutube]

FeaturesLocalization has been added! This is a rough first pass and more iterations are will occur for each language. The game now supports the following Languages:Spanish
German
Dutch
Italian
Swedish

Tower Table filters have been added, among other improvements!Filters are sorted by Range, and then Support filters.
You can also hover over an Element or Tower to highlight related towers.We're aware the pop-up info can block some of this and we'll be implementing a fix on this soon.

The Tower Table has also been added to the Main Menu! Additionally, you can preview builds:Left-click to increase an element's level.
Right-click to decrease the element's level.


ImprovementsFurther network improvements, as usual.
Lobbies no longer auto-start when they hit 8 Players.
F2 now only jumps between living players.
Duel Mode: Frost Zone now prevents affected towers from being upgraded.


Bug FixesAttempt number 2 at fixing the mid-game disconnect bug.If anyone's still running into this, please let us know.

Fixed a bug where trying to kick a player wouldn't actually work.
Fixed a bug where Challenges were locked in at 30 Creeps per Wave, which resulted in certain challenges becoming outright impossible.
Fixed inconsistency in button sounds on the Main Menu.
Fixed the Scoreboard hiding itself when the Game Over Screen popped up.
Fixed a bug where playing on Extreme + 2 Paths caused the number of Ronalds to increase by an exponential amount for each wave that passed.
Duel Mode: Fixed a bug where all lives gained as a result of Life Tower were going to Player 1.


BalanceEasy Score Modifier increased from x0 to x0.25
The Speed Score Multiplier will now drop to a minimum of x0.5, instead of dropping all the way to x0.

Also, for this weekend, Element TD 2 is on sale for $8.99 (10% off). Get your friends, family, strangers, and mortal enemies aboard and play some games!

More languages are currently in progress and will be releasing over the next week or so. We're also looking to translate to more languages, particularly:Russian
Korean
Japanese
Thai

notes.title: Version 0.46 - Ronald Runs, Menu Updates, Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Features
Ronald Run length option added!Start from Wave 56 with 120,000 Gold, 11 Element Picks, & A Freebie Essence
You have 180 Seconds to prepare your defenses
This is actually submittable to the Leaderboard; however, the Speed Multiplier is set to x1. Between that and 120k Gold, any decent Full length run (or even Extra Short) should beat out a Ronald Run.

Removed the unintuitive "search for game" menu for Duel Mode.When hosting a game, it lets you host between FFA, Co-op, or 1v1 Duel.


Bug Fixes
Fixed random disconnect errors that would happen mid-game.
When a player leaves in Co-op, it properly decreases the current player count for splitting the bounty.
In-game difficulty score multiplier on Easy properly displays x0 instead of x1.
Fixed a bug where going to the Audio Tab in in-game settings could mess up the UI.
Fixed a bug where Chatbox vanishes twice as fast on Turbo.
Fixed a bug where where "You've won the game" notification would pop-up during Ronalds, even if you ultimately lose.


Improvements
You can no longer get randomed Double Interest Upgrades when playing on Easy, Normal, or Hard Difficulties.Double Interest is only something experienced players are able to take proper advantage of and often screws over new players. If you want Double Interest on Random, start raising the Difficulty.

Further server improvements to reduce pauses.
Lobby List Filters are now hidden by default.
Further optimizations made.Unfortunately, late-game Co-op is still a lagfest. We'll be addressing this over the coming weeks.

Co-op pre-game time is now doubled, instead of a flat +30 Seconds.
More sounds added/updated, including Lobby Ready Up & Unready.
After typing something in the Chatbox, pressing Enter again will cause it to go away.
On Blacksmith, Well, Trickery, Runic & Astral Towers, after using their abilities, the ability icon now displays the cooldown remaining.
Hotkey page is now up to date.



Since the release of Element TD 2 on Steam Early Access, we've primarily prioritized Multiplayer Functionality, new modes, network improvements, bug fixes, and other new features; however, the Singleplayer department has been sorely lacking in new content.

Over the new few months, our focus will be shifting more towards Content & Accessibility. Look forward to the following:
A Campaign with actual progress and unlocks (this will replace Challenges)
Steam Achievements
A rewards system, providing Skins & Trails
And more!


It will take us some time to actually build out and implement these things, so don't expect them to happen immediately. In the meantime, expect our usual bout of maintenance updates, including further network improvements, performance optimizations, visual & audio updates, etc.

notes.title: Version 0.45 - Co-op Alpha, Optimizations, & Fixes
notes.content:
Since release, we've had a lot of people ask if Co-op is getting added to the game. Originally, we were going to wait, due to how long it'll take to build the map's visuals out, but we've decided to forgo making it look pretty in favor of getting the mode playable and out there to you all!

https://i.imgur.com/O9rzmY5.jpg

Features
Co-op Mode added! Up to 8 players join together on a mega map to defend against 8 incoming lanes of creeps!Starting gold and bounty from creep kills are split evenly between players
Builder movement speed is increased on this mode, allowing you to get around the map faster.
Abuse the buffing powers of Blacksmith, Well & Trickery to empower your allies!

Major Optimizations have been applied:Any towers making use of that fancy water shader (Water, Well, Wisp, Golem, Flooding, and apparently Blacksmith) have been altered to use a more performant water shader.
GPU Usage has been drastically cut down, thanks to turning off certain settings that didn't really do anything for our game.
Creeps no longer have mesh colliders. We're not sure why they had them in the first place, but if you had lag when there were a bunch of creeps on screen, it should be much smoother now.

Updated the visuals of many towers, particularly their scaling.Higher level towers have been made a bit bigger. It should be easier to tell them apart from their lower level counterparts.

Updated Sound & Music selection.


Improvements
By popular request, pressing 1 now selects the Builder.F1 will still do this as well.

Pressing F3 will now reset your zoom level.
Alt+Left Click on the Minimap to ping a location.
Scoreboard is now toggled on at the start of the game by default.
Playing on God Mode now prevents you from getting a personal score.
Added a Reset Scores button in settings, which will reset all of your personal scores.
Improved drag-select/drag-build responsiveness.
Duel Mode: Increased search time from 60 seconds to 90 seconds.
Duel Mode: Decreased Lockdown's AoE from 500 to 400.
Duel Mode: Fixed both players showing as Defeated.
Duel Mode: Fixed the winner not getting an Endgame Scorescreen.


Bug Fixes
Fixed a bug where Periodic could not be cloned by Trickery.
Fixed the crazy visual flare on Arrow Tower when it tried shooting at a creep that was leaking.
Fixed a bug where, even with the builder selected, you couldn't move if you happen to right-click a creep.
Fixed a bug where having the Timescale increased would result in the Game Notification pop-up disappearing that much quicker.
Fixed reported leaderboard score being rounded differently than the score reported in the Endgame Scorescreen.
Fixed elements being slightly offset on the Scoreboard in Multiplayer.

notes.title: Co-op Mode Alpha coming this weekend!
notes.content:
Coming this weekend, we're going to be releasing the Alpha version of Co-op Mode!

https://i.imgur.com/hkENzFw.jpg

FeaturesA prototype map with 8 lanes, featuring 8 fantastic sides, and 8 awesome angles!
Up to 8 players work together (or not) on this mega map!Bounty from creep kills is split evenly between all players.
Starting gold is also split evenly between players.
It's entirely possible to play this map solo. Not recommended, but possible.

Increased builder movespeed by 50% to get around this mega map.Just to clarify, this is just for Co-op.

Map visuals that remind you of the good ol' days, right when 3D became a thing.


Although we're calling this an Alpha, do note it'll be fully playable. Mainly what'll change over time is likely the map design itself (for the first month, as it gets publicly tested), followed by actual non-prototype map visuals. Due to the vast scale of the map, this is probably going to take upwards of 2-3 months. So in the meantime, we decided that, since people have been asking for Co-op repeatedly, that we'd forgo visuals for now and just release the mode.

Also coming in this weekend's update are a bunch of optimizations, updated relative tower scaling, visual updates, fixes, and improvements to Duel Mode.

notes.title: Version 0.44 - New Map, Duel Mode, Bots, And More
notes.content:
Version 0.44 is here, and with it, a new map, new ways to play, bots to trash, and a host of other features, fixes, and improvements! As this patch does include balance changes, including layout tweaks to some of our maps, Leaderboards have been reset.

[previewyoutube=V8LQyYDaGZw;full][/previewyoutube]

Read on below for the full details of the patch notes!

New Map: Temple
https://i.imgur.com/VKiYnDa.jpg
It's fairly compact, symmetrical, and features more trees than our actual Forest map. Length-wise, it clocks in the same length as Autumn & Desert, so don't take it lightly!

Duel Mode
[previewyoutube=k3LhoF_J_y4;full][/previewyoutube]
Both players are in the same area. On one side, your creeps spawn, and on the other side, the opponent's creeps spawn. The goal of this game is to kill the opponent's creeps while keeping yours alive, using both Towers and powerful new Abilities.

When an opponent's creep passes by, your towers will shoot and damage it, just like in the normal game. However, when one of your creeps passes by, your towers will shoot and heal it. On top of competing for build locations, you'll have to constantly adapt playstyle to counter the opponent.

Additionally, you have a pair of two abilities you can use. Each time you use one, you're given a new ability at random after a cooldown. Currently, there are 5 Abilities in the game:Speed Up: All of your creeps are sped up by 50% for 15 seconds. 90 Second Cooldown
Rejuvenation: All of your creeps are healed by 50% of their Maximum Health. 90 Second Cooldown
Mega Creep: Spawn a Mega Creep from the current wave with 500% Health, which reduces Lives by 5 instead of 1. 60 Second Cooldown
Frost Zone: Decrease the Attack Speed of all enemy towers in an area by 50% for 15 seconds. Also prevents them from being sold. 60 Second Cooldown
Lockdown: Sell and full refund all towers in an area, preventing anyone from building there for 60 seconds. 120 Second Cooldown


In order to play Duel Mode, go to the Duel Mode tab, select your settings, and hit Find Game. Just like hosting a lobby, this'll trigger a Game Notification, prompting anyone to answer your challenge.

New Features
You can now play against Bots in Singleplayer!Up to 3 Bots can be added to your game.
If you're experienced with the game, odds are, you're going to trash these Bots. However, if you're new and relatively inexperienced, it gives you a chance to improve your skills in an offline environment and potentially learn from them.
We'll be improving and expanding upon this feature with each patch.

Interest can now be disabled!For those of you that want to play the game without buy/sell abuse, you can turn off the Interest and make the game a match of pure knowledge and strategy.

Turbo Mode has been added!Multiplayer feel too sluggish without access to Timescale Options? Fret not; just turn on Turbo Mode, and force the game's Timescale to x2!


Map Updates
https://i.imgur.com/QRjH8nY.jpg
Every Map can now be either 1 Path or 2 Paths!By default, this is set to 1 Path, even if the map itself supports two lanes.
Kick it to 2 Paths, and single-lane maps change to Purple Portals, while two lanes add a second set of Blue & Red Portals.
Also, this increases the wave timer between each wave by 4 Seconds, meaning it's actually possible to play Extreme on 2 Paths without instantly melting now.


Additionally, the Desert & Winter maps have been updated:

Desert
https://i.imgur.com/Q7KqVUx.jpg
Extra build areas were added to the Desert Map to block off parts of the path creeps weren't really walking on. In addition, the portals have been tweaked such that it's actually symmetrical this time.

Winter
https://i.imgur.com/tLfxYgw.jpg
The Winter Map has been overhauled with a new layout. Although we want this map to be difficult, the previous layout was unfair to many of the game's towers. With this update, it's still difficult, but it's much friendlier to most builds.

Fixes & Improvements
Further improvements have been made to server stability, resulting in less pauses, reduced input lag, and hopefully no more spontaneous disconnects.
Creep healthbar color changed to red.
Cleaned up Lobby UI.
F1 hotkey functionality tweaked:Pressing it once simply selects your Builder.
Pressing it twice will center your camera on your Builder.

Bringing up the menu in-game now shows you the current game's difficulty and settings.
If you're the last player alive in a Multiplayer Game, the game will tell you that you've won, giving you a prompt to continue playing or exit to the Main Menu.
Camera bounds have been expanded just slightly.
You can now zoom out way further than before.
 -- Beware, zooming out to the new maximum can be performance heavy.
The game's shadows have been improved, particularly at a distance, meaning trees no longer look like garbage when viewing them from afar.
Fixed a bug where failing to host or join a lobby would kill the UI, forcing you to Alt+F4 to get out.
Fixed a bug where players quitting and rejoining a lobby would cause the playerIndex to get screwed over, messing up the game and the replay.
Fixed a bug where you couldn't change sound settings in the Main Menu.


Balance
You can now read up on the same charts that I use to balance the game here:Element TD 2 DPS/Gold Values Chart
Score Multipliers updated:Full Length multiplier now starts at 5.5, degrading by 0.1 per minute:
 -- If you clear the game in 30 Minutes, you'll have a score multiplier of x2.5
 -- If you clear the game in 45 Minutes, you'll have a score multiplier of x1
 -- If you clear the game in 55 Minutes, you'll have a score multiplier of x0
Short multiplier starts at 4.8
Extra Short multiplier starts at 3.5

Light consecutive damage bonus reduced from 8 / 48 / 288 / 2880 to 6 / 36 / 216 / 2160
Darkness damage bonus on death reduced from 15% to 12%
Water damage increased from 70 / 420 / 2520 / 25200 to 75 / 450 / 2700 / 27000
 -- Bonus damage reduced from 50% to 40%
Fire damage increased from 24 / 144 / 864 / 8640 to 25 / 150 / 900 / 9000
Nature damage increased from 70 / 420 / 2520 / 25200 to 75 / 450 / 2700 / 27000
Electricity now requires at least one other creep in range in order to bounce
 -- Attack Rate reduced from 1 to 0.66
 -- Damage increased from 200 / 800 / 3200 to 300 / 1200 / 4800
 -- Bounce range increased from 900 to 1150
 -- Number of bounces increase from 4 to 6
Vapor damage bonus per creep reduced from 14% to 10%
 -- Damage increased from 150 / 600 / 2400 to 180 / 720 / 2880
Arcane damage reduced from 650 / 2600 / 10400 to 600 / 2400 / 9600
Atom damage reduced from 270 / 1080 / 4320 to 260 / 1040 / 4160
Money extra bounty bonus increased from 30% / 45 to 35% / 50%
Runic ability AoE increased from 175 to 200


And that's it for this week's mega patch! Next week, look forward to an early version of Co-op Mode, complete with a prototype map. It won't look as fancy as the rest of our maps, but it'll be fully playable!

If you're having trouble finding online games, join us on our Discord and request a Looking-For-Game role:
Join our Discord

notes.title: Version 0.43.1 - Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Fixes & Improvements
Applied more server optimizations. This should result in less pauses, particularly in multiplayer.
Server pauses no longer bring up the chatbox.
Fixed a bug where you could use the Game Notification to join a game after it's started or no longer exists.

Removed "Wave 0" column from the Leaderboard.
Extended the double-click threshold from 0.15 seconds to 0.3 seconds
Arrow & Cannon Towers are no longer buffable by Well & Blacksmith
 -- Apparently, this was an OP tactic that unleashed their final forms, allowing them to overthrow forms of godhood.

notes.title: Version 0.43 - Game Notifications
notes.content:
Features
Game Notifications have been added!How this works is on the title screen, there's a new toggle in the bottom-left corner.
If it's on, then as long as you're in the menu, playing offline singleplayer, or Challenges, you'll get a notification each time someone hosts a game.
You'll see a pop-up telling you the game's settings. If you accept, it'll confirm if you want to exit your current game, and then if so, you'll instantly join the lobby!

3 New Lava Challenges added!Escalation
Big Bad Bosses
Duos

Quick Play temporarily removed for now.It wasn't doing any favors splitting the low playerbase. We'll add it back down-the-road later.


Fixes & Improvements
Arrow & Cannon Towers can no longer be cloned by Trickery.
Fixed a bug where building a Trickery Tower near Arrow and/or Cannon Towers would pseudo-freeze the game.
Fixed a bug where left-clicks sometimes wouldn't register.
Fixed a bug where playing on Random would cause it to carry over to Challenges.
Fixed Brightness Slider not doing anything in-game.
Added a Max Channels slider for sounds.

Timeout window increased.

Improved the lighting on the Autumn map.

notes.title: Version 0.42 - Drag-Build, Score System, & Balance Changes
notes.content:
Welcome to the first balance update of Element TD 2! Due to the number of changes on a larger scale this build, the Leaderboards have been reset. For the future though, we'll be keeping these kinds of updates sparse, happening only once every month or so.

[previewyoutube=tSL3wi1xZGk;full][/previewyoutube]

Features
You can now Click, Hold, & Drag Outwards to build a whole box of towers with a single click!
In other words, your index finger will no longer die after a single game or so of buy/sell abuse.

That dastardly Cross Region option has been nuked from the game!
Thanks to recent network improvements, we no longer need a Cross Region latency option to account for those with lesser internet speeds, which makes searching for games much easier for everyone.
Input lag and the number of server pauses should be reduced from before.
If you're still having problems, please let us know!

New Challenges Added!
3 new Forest Challenges and 3 new Lava Challenges await you in a test of your skills!
A number of previous Challenges were adjusted to make them easier and scale better.
Unfortunately, this did reset progress for most of the existing Challenges. We apologize about that, and we'll try to avoid this in the future.

Updated Forest visuals!
Since release, the Forest map's visuals have been a little too red and not foresty enough. It's now been updated to look much cleaner and easier on the eyes.
You can check out a comparison of the new version to the old version here.


Score System
Duration now accounts for the time between the first wave starting a Wave 55 finishing
There is now a Speed Multiplier applied to your Ronald Score, based on your performance up through Wave 55:
On a Full Length Game, you start with a multiplier of x3.5. Every minute, this decreases by 0.05:
 -- If you clear the game in 40 Minutes, you'll have a multiplier of x1.5
 -- If you clear the game in 50 Minutes, you'll have a multiplier of x1
 -- If you clear the game in 70 Minutes, you'll have a multiplier of x0
On Short & Extra Short Modes, these multipliers start lower:
 -- Short: Start with a multiplier of x3
 -- Extra Short: Start with a multiplier of x2.25

Additionally, if you clear through Wave 55 without losing any lives, you'll gain a Perfection Bonus, multiplying your score by x1.1
 -- Note, if you lose lives but gain them back through Life Tower, this does not give you the Perfection Bonus


Improvements
Border Lock option added!
 -- If you're running a dual monitor setup, and you had issues with your mouse going off-screen and throwing you out of focus, you can turn Border Lock on to prevent this issue.
Brightness Slider added!
First-time players are forwarded to Challenges now.
Near targeting priority no longer focuses creeps down.
 -- However, Light, Atom, Arcane, & Flooding will now always focus creeps down, allowing you to change their targeting priority without breaking their effects.
Old targeting priority renamed to Front.
Added a Back targeting priority, which does the exact opposite of Front.
Decreased the size of stats pop-up boxes.
Damage number pop-up duration doubled.
Toned down the VFX on many of the projectiles.
Updated a number of tower tooltips to be generally clearer, including listing the damage formulas on Disease & Mushroom.


Fixes
Fixed Fire, Light, Nature, Atom, Ethereal, Golem, & Flooding Towers updating their buff numbers instead of their base numbers.
Fixed a bug where the Elements settings drop-down on Quick Play was offset by 1.
Fixed a bug where Blacksmith's Damage Buff was not buffing certain towers properly. This included:
 -- Earth's shockwave
 -- Solar's damage-over-time
 -- Quake's shockwave
 -- Nova's shockwave
 -- Flamethrower's napalm
Fixed a bug where certain towers with self-buffing effects were not gaining damage on any priority except Near. This included:
 -- Fire's damage-gain-over-time
 -- Atom's consecutive attacks
Element Prompt no longer shows up in God Mode.
Fixed a bug where the Interest Timer would unfreeze each time you cleared a wave of Ronalds.


Balance
All Build & Upgrade Times increased by 0.25 seconds
Ronald base HP reduced from 600,000 to 500,000
 -- However, Ronald per-wave-scaling increased from x1.1 to x1.2
Shield creep's ability cooldown increased from 5 to 6 seconds
Timelapse creep's ability trigger threshold reduced from 33% to 25%
 -- Effectively, it's now an even harder counter to Single-Targets
Healing creep's ability AoE increased from 175 to 200

Light's consecutive damage bonus reduced from 10 / 60 / 360 / 3600 to 8 / 48 / 288 / 2880
 -- Default priority changed from Near to Far
Darkness damage bonus on bounce reduced from 20% to 15%
Fire damage increased from 22 / 132 / 792 / 7920 to 24 / 144 / 864 / 8640
Earth's shockwave now deals damage in a Full/Half AoE instead of a Full AoE
 -- Shockwave damage increased from 30 / 180 / 1080 / 10800 to 40 / 240 / 1440 / 14400

Trickery now clones towers next to the cloned tower instead of Trickery
 -- Its behavior now matches all previous versions of the game
Atom default priority changed from Near to Back

Solar updated:
 -- Damage & damage-per-second increased from 80 / 320 / 1280 to 100 / 400 / 1600

 -- AoE increased from 100 to 200
 -- Ability AoE reduced from 300 to 200
 -- Effectively, this should perform much more consistently early on, and still scale well into the endgame
Mushroom effect reworded to not be a confusing mess.
 -- Although its numbers have changed, its balance is identical to before
Howitzer effect reworded to deal bonus damage on close-up creeps, instead of half damage to far away creeps.
 -- Although its numbers have changed, its balance is identical to before
Geyser updated:
 -- AoE increased from 0 to 200
 -- Attack Speed reduced from 1.5 to 1

 -- Damage bonus per creep reduced from 360 / 1440 / 5760 to 150 / 600 / 2400

Nova damage increased from 500 / 2000 to 600 / 2400
Wisp updated:
 -- Damage increased from 450 / 1800 to 500 / 2000
 -- AoE increased from 400 to 450
 -- Damage gain per attack reduced from 50 / 200 to 20 / 80
 -- AoE loss per attack reduced from 10 to 5
 -- Damage & AoE now cap after 50 attacks, stopping at 1500 / 6000 damage and 200 AoE
Runic damage increased from 850 / 3400 to 900 / 3600
Polar default priority changed from Strong to Back
Flooding damage increased from 330 / 1320 to 350 / 1400
 -- Default priority changed from Near to Back
Corrosion damage amp increased from 15% / 40% to 15% / 45%
Flamethrower Napalm AoE increased from 300 to 400
Impulse damage reduced from 3600 / 14400 to 3500 / 14000
Golem damage increased from 1300 / 5200 to 1400 / 5600
Quake Shockwave damage reduced from 4500 / 18000 to 3000 / 12000
 -- Shockwave now deals full damage to nearby creeps, instead of pretty much half across the board

Money bounty bonus increased from 30% / 40% to 30% / 45%

To celebrate the new patch, we'll be hosting a Community Night on Saturday, March 13th. Join us for some games at 6pm GMT, and later at 10pm GMT!

notes.title: Version 0.41.1 - Server Finding Fix
notes.content:
Improvements & Fixes
Fixed how the Region Bypass Filter works. You can pry from non-Cross Region into Cross Region, but you can no longer pry from Cross Region to non-Cross Region.
 -- Essentially, if your internet isn't particularly stable, this prevents you from entering games that would cause a spam of Server Pauses.
 -- We're well aware this whole Cross Region On/Off thing is super confusing, so we're looking into alternatives and further improvements for next week.
Added the ability to Reset to Defaults for Settings.
Fixed Quick Play on "Any" settings not actually searching for "Any" settings.
Fixed Timescale controls not accurately updating.
Fixed being unable to access the Menu during a Server Pause.
Fixed a number of typos.

notes.title: Version 0.41 - Network Optimizations & Easier Game Searches
notes.content:
Features
Network stability improved and optimized!
You should no longer receive spontaneous Disconnects, short of your internet going out too long.
Reduced server pauses.
Reduced input lag.
We're still working to improve and optimize it further, so if you run into any issues, please let us know!

Bypass Region Filter added!
Instead of having to go back and forth between the Settings and the Lobby List to change your Region/Cross Region settings, you can now bypass it with a handy little checkbox! Now, regardless of any hosted game's Region/Cross Region, you can see and join it!
This is on by default. Note, actual Region/Cross Region settings are based on the host.


Improvements
A Hotkeys tab has been added in Settings.
 -- It doesn't let you change hotkeys, it just tells you what they all are.
Your Personal High Score is now listed on each map.
 -- This does include your Offline score attempts. We'll build something out later to make this more in-depth.
Wave Clear messages have been shoved to the side and are kindly out of your way now.
Time Scale controls changed:
 -- From: x1, x2, x3, x5, x7
 -- To: x1, x2, x4, x7, x10
The Offline setting in Singleplayer now remembers your preference between play sessions.
If you have the Tower Table open, right-clicking anywhere on-screen will close it.
Double-clicking a Leaderboard Entry now opens the replay.
Leaderboards now show the Top 100 Entries, up from 50.
Dual Spawn Maps now only have one Path Indicator per spawn, but the trail length is doubled.
Color vibrance level has been increased.
Performance increases around tower and creep rendering.


Fixes
Fixed the game over pop-up covering a part of the Scoreboard.
Upgrading to a higher level tower no longer resets the Kills counter.
Hovering over the upgrade icon on a Tier 2 Triple no longer gives you a tooltip implying that there's a third tier.
Geyser & Flooding Towers should no longer set your computers on fire, despite being water towers. Huge performance gains here!



Regarding New Challenges, we'll be adding a few by this weekend, so look forward to them!

notes.title: Version 0.40.3 - Challenges are actually possible now
notes.content:
Fixes & Improvements
The following challenges have been neutered in difficulty and should actually be possible to beat on Insane now:
 -- Shortcuts
 -- Forest Peninsulas
 -- Poisoning the Forest
 -- Basics: Expendables
Fixed a bug where, after playing a solo online game, the checkbox for "Offline/Online" would be flipped.
Fixed a bug where the screen would flicker each time you exited an online game.
Added a confirmation prompt for restarting the game in singleplayer.

notes.title: Version 0.40.2 - More Hotfixes
notes.content:
Improvements
In Quick Play, all options now default to "Any". This means you can boot up the game and just hit "Find Game", without having to change any settings.
 -- This should drastically improve the frequency of finding other games.
 -- You're welcome to still rig your settings up, but if you don't care and just want to play, just hit "Find Game" without changing anything.
When the host leaves a lobby, it unreadies everyone.
 -- This fixes a bug where the lobby could end up bugged out, and people could join an in-progress game.
In Singleplayer, your choices for Elements is just between Pick and Random now.
Doubled the amount of path indicators.
Leaderboard scroll speed increased.
Leaderboard entries no longer display Interest & Essences that are 0.
In-game loading timeout in multiplayer decreased from 120 seconds to 60 seconds.


Bug Fixes
Fixed a bug where the in-game chat would have everyone spamming the text "HEARTBEAT".
Fixed Autumn Map's second exit being slightly offset.
Fixed in-game chat scrollbar being reversed.
Fixed hover-over tooltip in Settings getting stuck on your screen and never going away.

notes.title: Version 0.40.1 - Server Stability
notes.content:
Fixes
Red text error log no longer shows up in the bottom-left corner.
Improved server stability, decreasing the chances of disconnects.
 -- Note, this does increase input lag. We'll be trying to optimize this over time, ideally reducing disconnects and input lag.
You can no longer join a game that's in-progress.
Difficulty now lists Score Multipliers in the tooltip.

notes.title: Release Update!
notes.content:
Element TD 2 is finally going public today! Spread the word, tell your friends, and especially invite your enemies, so that you can trounce them yourself!

This update contains the combined changelogs of Version 0.39 and 0.40

Features
Main Menu has a fancy new backdrop!
The game has been optimized:
The initial boot-up might end up slower than before, but in-game loading speeds should be much faster than before, even if you're on a HDD.
This should result in a much more stable online experience and prevent infinite hangs on loading online games.

Servers have also been optimized. Playing online should be considerably more stable than before.
You can now directly invite your friends to a Lobby!
If your friend is in a Lobby, you can also join them without an invitation. Just open the Steam Overlay, right-click your friend, and hit Join Game.
Note, it will use the host's Region & Cross Region settings, so via this method, you don't have to align region settings to join a friend. However, we recommend it for a more stable playing experience.

4 New Challenges have been added!


Improvements
Menus now quickly fade in and out, instead of instantly appearing and disappearing.
Added new icons for tower stats.
Essence Cost is now noted in the upgrade tooltips for Tier 4 Singles & Periodic Tower.
The game's Music Selection has been updated.
 -- Two of the heavier, upbeat tracks were removed, as they felt out of place.
 -- Seven new tracks have been added.
When someone dies or disconnects, their name is now colorized, and it's listed in the game chat.
Tweaked a number of hover-over tooltips in the in-game UI such that they no longer hang to the side.
Updated Cross Region tooltip to clarify what exactly it does.
Wisp Tower now has a new base, instead of a flattened version of Well Tower, just in time for release!
Flamethrower Tower is now on fire to account for its lack of animation. Hopefully it doesn't explode on you!


Bug Fixes
Fixed a bug where Leaderboard entries recorded the player index incorrectly, resulting in a different replay than intended.
 -- Unfortunately, this isn't retroactive.
 -- As a result, all existing Leaderboard entries have been nuked.
Fixed a bug where if you played a game of Extreme Mode and then tried playing a Challenge afterwards, it would soft-lock the game.
Fixed Fire Tower Level 3 not animating while idle.
Fixed Wisp Tower's AoE not updating in real-time when selecting the tower.
Fixed the "spash" typo.
Fixed a typo on Impulse Tower where it actually stated "the further the damage, the greater the damage".


Balance
Solar damage and damage-per-second increased from 75 / 300 / 1200 to 80 / 320 / 1280

notes.title: Version 0.38 - Quick Play, F2, and other Improvements
notes.content:
Features
Quick Play added! Set your modes, hit "Find Game", and if you find other people playing the same settings, you'll be on your way to a new game!
The game will wait up to 60 seconds. If don't find a game within that time, the game bounces you back.
Note that until the game officially releases, this feature is admittedly kind of useless.

Pressing F2 now bounces your camera to other players' zones, instead of their builders.


Improvements
The Tower Table has gotten a little reskin and should be sleeker than before.
Hovering over an upgrade you don't have access to will now display the tooltip.
When a lobby fills up all the way, it will now automatically start, regardless of if everyone's Ready or not.
 -- We'll update this later so it doesn't trigger in Private Lobbies.
Updated Geyser's water shader, this should hlep optimize the tower, though it'll still get laggy if you get more than 30 on-screen at once.
When someone quits or disconnects from a game, their quit message is now posted in the chat, and their name is colorized.
During a Server Pause, the Menu button no longer shows up on-screen.


Bug Fixes
Fixed a bug where the game would tell you Victory! even if you had lost.
Fixed a bug where the game completion message would trigger for everyone each time someone cleared Wave 55.
Fixed a bug where you could kick someone in a lobby after the countdown starts.
Fixed the random box covering part of your view when you were dead.
Fixed certain buttons on the Main Menu not making a sound.
Fixed Life Tower's tooltip listing "kils" instead of "kills".
Fixed a bug where Builder & Elemental Text would invert colors when in the top-left corner of the screen.
In-game Scroll, Zoom, & Rotate sliders now reduce to a minimum of 10%, matching the Main Menu versions.
Potentially fixed a bug where you could hang infinitely on the loading screen.
 -- If you run into this bug still, please let us know.

notes.title: Version 0.37.2 - Hotfix for Challenges Freezing the Game
notes.content: -- Fixed a bug where opening any Challenge level would freeze the game.

notes.title: Version 0.37.1 - Replay from Leaderboard
notes.content:
Features
You can now view Replays from a leaderboard entry! To do so, simply click on any leaderboard entry, and hit the Replay button.
Once you're in, you can even Timescale it up to x7.

South America added to the Region Select.


Fixes
Playing with Cross Region enabled now actually lets you play with people on other Regions.
Fixed in-game chat being buggy and an absolute pain to deal with.
Fixed a bug where leaderboard entries based on Random Map were not uploading properly.
 -- Unfortunately, this isn't retroactive, so these entries were nuked.
Updated descriptions on existing Challenges.


Balance
Solar damage and damage-per-second increased from 75 / 300 / 1200 to 80 / 320 / 1280

notes.title: Version 0.37 - Leaderboards & Balance
notes.content:
Features
Leaderboards are now accessible!
For any game that you play online and reach Ronalds (killing at least 1), your score will be submitted to the Leaderboard.
Leaderboards are first divided into Pick & Random, and then by map, effectively providing 14 Different Leaderboards to compete for.

You can now rotate the camera on the X Axis, using the Home & End buttons.
Like before, Page Up/Down still rotate the camera on the Y Axis. Use F1 to reset your camera rotation.


Optimizations & Bug Fixes
Fixed a bug where game would infinitely hang on the loading screen.
Improved network stability, resulting in far less Server Pauses and Disconnects.
Rebaked and optimized lightmaps, shaving about 1 GB off the game size.
 -- This should help with excessive load times.
Updated texture compression and mip maps; this should improve in-game performance.


Tweaks & Improvements
The first time the game loads, you'll be prompted to select your Region.
 -- You can always change this in Settings.
Renamed Latency to Cross Region.
 -- By default, this is set to Disabled.
In-game time is now displayed in the bottom-right corner, above the Minimap.
Your Builder now shows up as a blip on the Minimap.
When you return to the Main Menu, you now return to the last location you were at instead of the Title Screen.
When you beat Wave 55, you receive a congratulatory message.
If you're playing by yourself in an online game, it will no longer tell you "Victory!" if you die before Wave 55.
Missions have been renamed to Challenges.
You are no longer locked to playing Challenges in order.
Extreme Mode tweaked:
 -- You can no longer random Interest Upgrades in Extreme Mode.
 -- When a creep leaks, it no longer freezes the Interest Timer.
 -- You now get the Element Pick when the respective wave finishes spawning, not when you kill it.
All Maps now list a short description.
Applied a new icon for the Tower Table.
Fixed a visual discrepancy where selecting your Elements could sometimes cause the element icons in your HUD to be darker than intended.


Balance
Cursed creeps effect AoE increased from 200 to 350
 -- This effectively causes it to hit all towers up to 2 spaces away
 -- Effect amount decreased from 15% to 10% per stack
 -- Effect duration increased from 10 to 15 seconds
Earth ability starting AoE increased from 50 to 100
 -- Fixed Reset time not being 3 seconds
Arcane damage reduced from 720 / 2880 / 11520 to 700 / 2800 / 11200
Vapor damage reduced from 160 / 640 / 2560 to 150 / 600 / 2400
 -- Bonus damage per creep hit increased from 14% to 15%
Geyser AoE reduced from 100 to 0
 -- Bonus damage per creep within its 200 search AoE increased from 120 / 480 / 1920 to 360 / 1440 / 5760
Poison damage-per-second reduced from 90 / 360 / 1440 to 80 / 320 / 1280
 -- Duration increased from 8 to 10 seconds
Solar attack speed decreased from 1.5 to 1
 -- Damage & damage-per-second increased from 65 / 260 / 1040 to 75 / 300 / 1200
 -- Primary attack AoE increased from 0 to 100
 -- Effect altered from "Primary target receives a stacking debuff" to "Targets hit receive a stacking debuff"
Mushrooom attack speed increased from 1.5 to 3
 -- Damage reduced from 240 / 960 / 3840 to 150 / 600 / 2400
 -- Effect altered from "This tower deals 1% additional damage for every 1% of HP the target has" to "This tower deals up to 50% more damage against max health enemies and down to 50% less damage against low health enemies".
 -- Its maximum DPS is about the same as before, but it doesn't deal as much damage to lower health creeps early on, preventing it from steamrolling the early-game with minimal effort
Impulse damage reduced from 3800 / 15200 to 3600 / 14400
Flooding bonus AoE per attack increased from 18 to 20
Nova damage increased from 400 / 1600 to 450 / 1800
Windstorm damage-per-second increased from 450 / 1800 to 500 / 2000
All Tier 1 Slows reduced from 12% to 10%

notes.title: Version 0.36
notes.content:
Features
Main Menu has received some welcome visual updates, particularly in the backdrop.
Missions have been added! You can find this under Singleplayer.
These are short levels with a smaller number of waves and usually preset Elements.
The 6 that have been added so far help teach the basics of the game. Do note they are designed for Normal Difficulty, so if you want a challenge, crank them up to Very Hard or Insane.

Add a Replays feature.
Every game you play will always store a Replay. To check out your latest game, click the Replay button, sort by Last Modified, and select the top-most Replay.

The old Pop-Up Tutorial has been removed.
It's been replaced by the far superior Missions.

Extreme Mode has been changed!
Before, all it did was reduce you to 1 Life.
Now, when a wave finishes spawning, the next wave immediately starts. In other words, it's Rush Mode from the Dota 2 version.


Tweaks & Fixes
Temporarily disabled the Quick Play feature.
 -- It'll return soon.
You can no longer drag the camera out-of-bounds using the minimap.
Your Steam Avatar is now displayed next to your name on the Scoreboard.
There is now an indicator for when you hover the mouse over a tower.
The Tower Table button now lists the Space hotkey.
Fixed a bug where hitting Restart in Singleplayer would play the Menu Music.


Balance
Interest now rounds down instead of up.
Reverted Total Bounty decrease from 0.35
Solar damage increased from 60 / 240 / 960 to 65 / 260 / 1040
Life damage increased from 480 / 1920 / 7680 to 500 / 2000 / 8000
Mushroom damage decreased from 250 / 1000 / 4000 to 240 / 960 / 3840
Flamethrower damage decreased from 300 / 1200 to 280 / 1120
 -- Napalm damage decreased from 150 / 600 to 140 / 560
 -- Napalm no longer expires after 5 seconds
